name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.machine.view.TransferSuccessActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK displays the result of a completed machine transfer. The layout shows fields for machine type, payment and cashback details, quantity, and recipient, plus a continue-transfer button.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the transfer confirmation screen.
